about.title: A little about me
body: I'm Tadashi — a CS student at the University of Aizu in Fukushima, spending my time between two ML internships. At 2WINS, Inc. I prototype models and ship them into real applications; at AVILEN, Inc. I work on AI engineering and education. What keeps pulling me back to this field is the gap between a paper and a product — closing it means understanding the math well enough to reimplement it, and the engineering well enough to make it serve someone.

I learn by rebuilding. A lot of my projects are from-scratch studies — a mini GPT in pure PyTorch, the "Deep Learning from Scratch" book redone in NumPy, classical and deep-learning pipelines benchmarked side by side. When I'm not shipping or studying, I'm usually on Kaggle, reading a paper, or chasing a footnote someone else would've skipped.
